title: Fixed Hollow Cuff Boxing Glove Display
description: One newly authored complete static empty boxing-glove visual display. A thick changing-width curled-fist body rises and rounds forward over a real recessed wrist cavity, with an independently closed inward-curled padded thumb embedded at its root and tip. A complete wide annular wrist cuff and narrow solid binding retain a genuinely open lower wrist aperture rather than a black decal. This is not a hand cropped from the raincoat worker: that old whole figure has simple three-section solid straight glove roots with no separate curled thumb, padded knuckle profile or open glove wrist. All glove geometry is new, three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and complete horizontal-bounds-centred ground origin. One glove counts as one prop, zero scenes; no fist, wearer, partner glove, laces, logo or training scene. Fixed static artistic appearance only, no precise hand anatomy, wearer fit, fastening, padding response, impact absorption, punching performance, sport compliance, manufacture or protective/sports safety claim.
